title: Max Events That Can Be Attended

monster.name: Calendar Wraith
monster.title: Scheduler of Fleeting Days
monster.defeatQuote: Maximum distinct events attended on distinct days!

description: You are given an array of `events` where `events[i] = [startDayi, endDayi]`. You can attend event `i` at any day where `startDayi <= d <= endDayi`. You can only attend one event at any given day. Return the maximum number of events you can attend.
solutionCode:
def maxEvents(events: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    import heapq
    events.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    pq = []
    attended = 0
    day = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(events)
    while i < n or pq:
        if not pq:
            day = events[i][0]
        while i < n and events[i][0] <= day:
            heapq.heappush(pq, events[i][1])
            i += 1
        while pq and pq[0] < day:
            heapq.heappop(pq)
        if pq:
            heapq.heappop(pq)
            attended += 1
            day += 1
    return attended
hints: Simulate day by day. On each day, greedily attend the open event that finishes earliest (min-heap).
